title: Sniffing, ARP spoofing and taking a session over on the wire

videos.script: Anybody on a segment can listen to it. A defender does, all day, with a sensor. {{sensor}} So the question is not whether somebody can hear the traffic. It is what there is to hear. {{hear}} In this lesson the lab's sensor records a request sent in plain HTTP, and reads the page, the program and the session cookie. Then the same request over HTTPS, and reads nothing but its size. {{tls}} Next, ARP, the protocol that believes whoever answers. You will ask it a question by hand, and see two machines answer for one address. {{arp}} Then the defences that make a lie fail: in the switch, on the host, and in the application. {{defences}} Last, why a session cookie deserves the care of a password. {{cookie}}
